Name: The Long Road to Empire
Description: A five-part single-player campaign built in the classic 0 A.D. scenario style. Establish a foothold, secure the river, break the siege, cross the frontier, and win the final battle.

awakening.Name: I — A New Dawn
awakening.Description: Your people have reached a contested frontier. Establish a sustainable settlement, secure the nearby resources, and prepare the army that will carry the campaign forward.

river.Name: II — The River Crossing
river.Description: The enemy controls the river and the approaches beyond it. Build your economy, establish control of the crossings, and break the opposing position.

heartland.Name: III — The Heartland
heartland.Description: The road now leads into richer country. Expand carefully, protect your supply lines, and turn your growing settlement into a regional power.

frontier.Name: IV — The Narrow Bridge
frontier.Description: A narrow passage is the key to the frontier. Control the approach, deny it to the enemy, and force a way through without wasting your army.

finale.Name: V — The Last Fleet
finale.Description: The final resistance has taken to the coast. Assemble the forces needed for the decisive engagement and end the campaign on your terms.
